text: The two sources disagree. Article 113 of the Regulation gives 2 August 2027 for Article 6(1) and the corresponding obligations. The Commission FAQ states a different date: The rules for high-risk AI systems will apply starting 2 December 2027. The regulation text is the binding source.

citations.citedText: c) Artikel 6 Absatz 1 und die entsprechenden Pflichten gemäß dieser Verordnung gelten ab dem 2. August 2027.
The rules for high-risk AI systems will apply starting 2 December 2027.
